classification: Level C methodological boundary extension; isolated candidate
trigger: original native TAL and independent same-TAL both provide no positive nonzero supervision for valid NTGT
normal_path: call original estimator unchanged; original normal weights and outputs
candidates: pinned native GT geometric candidate rule; if empty, unique argmin GT-size-normalized center distance with native anchor-index ties
candidate_semantics: independent risk candidates, never called native TAL positives
classification_target: hard real GT NT class over same non-target logits; not zero native soft targets
